conditions.label: Has employees
conditions.description: Pays wages or salaries and runs a payroll.

conditions.label: Registered for VAT
conditions.description: Registered for value added tax or a similar turnover tax.

conditions.label: Listed on a stock exchange
conditions.description: Its shares trade on a regulated market.

profileFields.label: Company name
profileFields.description: The registered name, including the SC legal form. A company whose capital is divided into shares.

profileFields.label: Commercial registration number
profileFields.description: The number the company register gave the company.

profileFields.label: Registered office address
profileFields.description: The address on the company register.

profileFields.label: Paid-up capital
profileFields.description: The capital the company was registered with. Leave it empty if the form has no share capital.

roles.label: Director
roles.description: Sits on the board and runs the company.

roles.label: Officer
roles.description: A senior officer named by the board.

setupSteps.title: Choose and check the SC name
setupSteps.description: Check the name is free in Ministry of Trade and Industry, Business Licensing and Registration Division and follows Eritrea's naming rules.
setupSteps.authority: Ministry of Trade and Industry, Business Licensing and Registration Division

setupSteps.title: Prepare the SC documents
setupSteps.description: Prepare the articles or statutes, the founders' details and the registered office. The registration process sets out what it needs. Eritrea has no online company register. Register with the Business Licensing and Registration Division of the Ministry of Trade and Industry in Asmara.
setupSteps.authority: Ministry of Trade and Industry, Business Licensing and Registration Division

setupSteps.title: Register the SC
setupSteps.description: Submit the incorporation documents as Ministry of Trade and Industry, Business Licensing and Registration Division requires. The company exists once the register enters it.
setupSteps.authority: Ministry of Trade and Industry, Business Licensing and Registration Division

setupSteps.title: Register the SC for tax
setupSteps.description: Register with Ministry of Trade and Industry, Business Licensing and Registration Division for the company's tax number and any VAT or payroll accounts it needs.
setupSteps.authority: Ministry of Trade and Industry, Business Licensing and Registration Division

setupSteps.title: Register as an employer
setupSteps.description: Before the first hire, register with Ministry of Trade and Industry, Business Licensing and Registration Division for payroll and social contributions.
setupSteps.authority: Ministry of Trade and Industry, Business Licensing and Registration Division

setupSteps.title: Open a business bank account
setupSteps.description: Banks usually ask for the registration certificate and the tax number.

setupSteps.title: Check licences for your activity
setupSteps.description: Some activities need a permit or a licence from a sector regulator. Check before you start trading.

obligations.title: Annual return or confirmation statement
obligations.description: Check whether an annual return or confirmation statement is due with Ministry of Trade and Industry, Business Licensing and Registration Division, then file it and keep the company record current.
obligations.authority: Ministry of Trade and Industry, Business Licensing and Registration Division

obligations.title: Annual financial statements
obligations.description: Prepare the annual accounts. Check whether they must be filed with Ministry of Trade and Industry, Business Licensing and Registration Division, the deadline and whether an audit is required.
obligations.authority: Ministry of Trade and Industry, Business Licensing and Registration Division

obligations.title: Corporate income tax return
obligations.description: Check the company's income tax filing with Ministry of Trade and Industry, Business Licensing and Registration Division, then file the return and pay by the dates it sets.
obligations.authority: Ministry of Trade and Industry, Business Licensing and Registration Division

obligations.title: VAT returns
obligations.description: File VAT returns with Ministry of Trade and Industry, Business Licensing and Registration Division and pay any VAT due. Check whether the company is registered and how often it files.
obligations.authority: Ministry of Trade and Industry, Business Licensing and Registration Division

obligations.title: Payroll taxes and social contributions
obligations.description: Withhold and remit payroll taxes and social contributions for employees through Ministry of Trade and Industry, Business Licensing and Registration Division. Check the rates and dates.
obligations.authority: Ministry of Trade and Industry, Business Licensing and Registration Division

obligations.title: Beneficial ownership information
obligations.description: Check whether the country requires a beneficial ownership filing. If it does, keep the record up to date and file it with Ministry of Trade and Industry, Business Licensing and Registration Division.
obligations.authority: Ministry of Trade and Industry, Business Licensing and Registration Division

obligations.title: Report changes to the register
obligations.description: Check what changes must be reported to Ministry of Trade and Industry, Business Licensing and Registration Division, then tell it about changes to the name, address, directors or share capital within its deadline.
obligations.authority: Ministry of Trade and Industry, Business Licensing and Registration Division

obligations.title: Renew licences and permits
obligations.description: Check which licences your activity needs and renew them before they expire.

obligations.title: Annual general meeting
obligations.description: Hold the annual general meeting and record the resolutions.

obligations.title: Audit the annual accounts
obligations.description: Have the annual accounts audited if the company meets the audit threshold.

obligations.title: Disclose market information
obligations.description: Publish information that could affect the share price as the market rules require.
